faq_items.question: How do I sell my gift card on RewardHub Pakistan?
faq_items.answer: Browse active campaigns on our platform, select the campaign matching your gift card brand and denomination, fill out the required submission details (code/proof), and choose your preferred payout method (EasyPaisa, JazzCash, or Bank Transfer).

faq_items.question: How much cash payout will I receive?
faq_items.answer: Every campaign clearly displays the exact fixed PKR cash reward you will receive upon verification. For example, submitting a Rs. 500 Xbox Gift Card campaign yields a fixed Rs. 350 cash payout directly to your account.

faq_items.question: How long does verification and payment take?
faq_items.answer: Our verification team checks submitted codes and proof within 6 to 12 hours. Once approved, the payment status changes to Payment Pending and cash is transferred directly via your chosen payment method.

faq_items.question: Are there any points, coins, or wallets involved?
faq_items.answer: No! RewardHub Pakistan is a direct gift card selling platform. There are zero points, coins, or loyalty systems. You receive direct PKR cash payouts.

faq_items.question: Is my submission data secure?
faq_items.answer: Yes. Submitted gift card details and proof are strictly confidential and protected by server-side access control. Only authorized verification administrators can inspect submission details.

faq_items.question: Are third-party brands officially affiliated?
faq_items.answer: RewardHub Pakistan operates independently to fulfill demand for digital gift card campaigns. Third-party brand names and logos belong to their respective owners.

campaigns.title: Xbox Gift Card Campaign
campaigns.description: Submit a valid Rs. 500 Xbox digital gift card code. Receive Rs. 350 direct cash payout upon verification.
campaigns.instructions:
1. Verify your Xbox code is unused and valid for Rs. 500.
2. Fill out the submission form below with your 25-character digital code.
3. Enter your EasyPaisa / JazzCash / Bank payout account details.
4. Submit and track verification in your seller dashboard.
campaigns.eligibility: Must be valid unused Xbox region code equivalent to Rs. 500.

campaigns.title: Microsoft Gift Card Campaign
campaigns.description: Submit a valid Rs. 1,000 Microsoft gift card code. Receive Rs. 750 direct cash payout.

2. Submit digital code along with purchase proof image if available.
3. Provide your payout account information.
4. Payment will be processed within 12h upon approval.
